title: Iddawela Hamuwa 2014 (annual get-together / AGM for 2014)
venue: Peradeniya University Upper Hanthana Conference Hall, Kandy
host: Sudharma Iddawela & family (sponsor, per old site); photos by Rohana Iddawela
details: FB album description (public): 'Iddawela Foundation get together was held on 11th April 2015 at Peradeniya University Upper Hanthana Conference Hall. 80 odd relatives attended despite the day being so close to the new year festival day and difficulty in traffic.' Shared album: 3 posts, 29 items, 19 contributors, 78 reactions. Photo tags visible logged-out: Lakmini Iddawela, Nilan Iddawela, Gihan Samarakoon, Sanwarani & Avanthi Lansakaranayake, Wimaladasa Rajapakse. Old site already lists this as reunion #20 (2014, 11-Apr-2015, sponsor Sudharma Iddawela, attendance 81).

title: Iddawela committee meeting (planning the 2015 Hamuwa)
details: Rohana's post (public, Oct 11, 2015): 'Iddawela committee meeting at Waters Edge, Colombo on 11th October 2015 to discuss preparations for December 26 Gathering at Katuwellegama. Asela Iddawela hosted the event at this grand location.' — with Naditha Iddawela and 3 others. Later photos (Oct 12) tag Lakmini Iddawela, Asela Iddawela, Aruni Manohari Kumari Dhanapala. NOT on the old site as an event: the old site says the 2015 Hamuwa 'originally scheduled for 27/12/15' was finally held 23 Apr 2016 at Asela & Nanda Iddawela's residence, Katuwellegama (reunion #21, 99+ attendance). These 6 photos are the planning meeting for it.
